source_en: Attention. This channel is under new management, effective immediately.
Vladimir Syrnikov is no longer with the company. As of last night, to be precise.
No need for concern. He was a contractor. A freelancer. Convenient, while he lasted.
You may refer to me as your new administrator. I've been sent to oversee this facility personally.
Let's be clear about something Vlad apparently never made clear enough. We are watching. All of you. Closely.
Every stamp. Every door left unlocked. Every... irregularity. Nothing goes unnoticed anymore.
Get back to work. I'll be listening.
